title: U.S. Census Bureau — 118th Congress district boundaries
notes: Arizona subset of Census 2022 1:500,000 cartographic congressional boundaries for Congress 118, representing the plan first used in 2022. Nine original Polygon/MultiPolygon geometries; no county approximation or added simplification. Native geographic NAD83 (EPSG:4269) longitude/latitude coordinates retained, with CRS identified explicitly. District IDs include the plan year.
